classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: Target structure file path will be supplied at runtime via params.target_pdb; the workflow cannot execute until this is provided.
Default binder length of 60 residues is used; no domain-size constraint was specified in the request.
Binder chain is assumed to appear as chain B and target chain as chain A in boltzgen refolded output; adjust chain identifiers if the adapter labels them differently.
Two independent seeds (42 and 123) provide minimal diversity across the 2-candidate budget.

design_only=false runs the full boltzgen pipeline (diffusion + inverse-folding + refolding + filter), producing a predicted PDB and PAE matrix per shard that are consumed directly by ipsae without a separate prediction call.
Hotspot residues were not supplied; boltzgen will use unconstrained surface diffusion against the full target chain.
GPU budget assumed at 2 parallel shards, matching boltzgen default_max_parallel=2.
ipSAE default distance cutoff of 10 Å is adequate for first-pass interface triage; tighten dist_cutoff in a follow-up round if needed.
plan.goal: Generate two compact protein binder candidates against the user-supplied target using boltzgen full pipeline, score interface confidence with ipsae, and return a deterministically ranked top-2 list.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target structure (.pdb or .cif) — described as 'provided target structure' in the request but not attached; workflow cannot execute without it

success_criteria.min_candidates: rank_designs returns at least 1 ranked candidate with a numeric ipSAE score
success_criteria.ipsae_scored: both boltzgen shards complete refolding and both ipsae nodes return a numeric ipSAE score without error
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs top_k=2 list produced with deterministic ordering combining boltzgen filter metrics and ipsae scores
